fields.description: Classify each question first and send the model only the tools for that class (max 8). Unclassified questions keep the full tool set.
fields.label: Enable Tool Routing

fields.description: Users with this role may approve AI actions in addition to System Managers. Leave empty to allow System Managers only.
fields.label: Approver Role

fields.description: When enabled, the user who requested an action cannot approve it themselves.
fields.label: Require Four-Eyes Approval

fields.description: When enabled, System Managers can read other users' agent conversations. Every such read is recorded in Access Log. Disabled: each user sees only their own conversations.
fields.label: Allow Admin Conversation Audit

fields.description: Off (default): the agent never submits or cancels documents; submit/cancel tools are hidden and old requests are refused at execution.
fields.label: Allow Submit / Cancel Actions

fields.description: Managed: only Anthropic (Claude) providers are used. Own Key: other providers are allowed only with the consent below.
fields.label: Provider Mode

fields.description: Required for Gemini OCR, DeepSeek, OpenAI-compatible and Ollama providers. Business data in prompts, tool results and attachments goes to that provider.
fields.label: I Accept Sending Data to Third-Party Providers

fields.description: Own Key mode, one per line (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenAI Compatible, Ollama, Gemini OCR). Empty = all.
fields.label: Allowed Provider Types

fields.description: One fieldname (or part of a fieldname) per line, masked in every tool result before it reaches the model, on top of the built-in list (IBAN, bank accounts, IDs, passports, salaries).
fields.label: Extra Masked Fields

fields.description: One DocType per line whose amounts are masked like Salary Slip (per-person pay).
fields.label: Extra Masked DocTypes

fields.description: Override context window and vision support per model. The first row whose pattern matches the model name wins; models with no matching row use the built-in heuristics.
fields.label: Model Capabilities

fields.description: Expose the authenticated MCP endpoint for external AI clients.
fields.label: Enable MCP Server

fields.description: Agent policy applied to every MCP tool call. ERP Analyst is used when empty.
fields.label: MCP Agent

fields.description: Optional company context applied to MCP calls.
fields.label: MCP Company

fields.description: One Frappe role per line. The authenticated user must have at least one listed role.
fields.label: Allowed MCP Roles

fields.description: Expose action-request tools. They only create an approval request; document changes still require approval in Frappe.
fields.label: Enable MCP Action Requests

fields.description: On (default): every write from MCP waits for a human decision (card button or an explicit word in chat). Off: the requester's own requests execute immediately under their ERPNext permissions, and are still recorded as AI Approval Requests.
fields.label: MCP Actions Require Approval

fields.description: Let the MCP App approval card approve, edit or cancel a pending action with its buttons (signed one-time card token; the user's permissions are re-checked at execution). Off: approval happens in chat or in Frappe. Independent of 'MCP Actions Require Approval'.
fields.label: Allow Approval from MCP App

fields.description: Optional browser origins, one per line. Server-to-server clients normally send no Origin header.
fields.label: Allowed MCP Browser Origins

fields.description: Per authenticated user. Applies across web workers.
fields.label: MCP Requests per Minute

fields.description: Every skill or plugin is blocked until it is allowed here. A row with no role and no user applies to everyone. A user row overrides a role row; on a tie, deny wins. Automatic skills (always on) are not subject to this table.
fields.label: Skills & Plugins Access
